notes.title: The next update will be raising the players limit from 4 to 8 !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Since the release of Gatherings we've been listening to your feedback and have already made several updates. 

Today, we're preparing a new version whose main aim is to increase the number of players. We'll be raising the limit from 4 to 8 players for more fun!

Tests are currently underway, and news of this v2.0 will be coming very soon!

notes.title: Next update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
The next update will bring 2 new game modes!


 A new Loot - Dungeon mode, where you'll have to kill and then loot as many monsters as your opponents. Be careful, the loot can... and will be stolen !
 A new Memory mode, where you'll have to memorize the shopping list and then shop faster than your opponents. Of course, you can steal your friends' items.

notes.title: Gatherings 1.2.0 - Wheels update
notes.notes:
Features

- Ability to choose vehicles in relevant game modes
- 2 new vehicles (Fjord Blur - S-kive Fonceur)
- 1 new boost capability in Race gamemodes
- 1 new Time Attack map  (Time attack - City)
- 1 new Cook map (Cook - Pizza)
- Xbox Controller support in all menus
- Ability to switch hotbar items with scroll wheel or with Xbox D-PAD

Fixes

- Audio dropdown not displaying audio target when no selection
- Add missing videos for the two new maps of the 1.1.0 Patch
- Adjust light on Build Hanger
- Adjust spawn points on Stonehold Citadel
- Fix a bug where you could get stuck without focus after opening the menu in the waiting screen and the gaming starting while menu was open (ty @TheRealMarzaa)

notes.title: UPCOMING : Gatherings 1.2.0 - Wheels update
notes.notes:
The upcoming wheels update will bring new exciting features for the best drivers of the lot.


Choose your "wheels" !
You will now be able to choose which car you'll use at the beginning of each race modes.

Choose one of three : 

 The Tractorini, the fast supercar you already know. Good car all around but maybe a little heavy on the corners ?
 The Fjord Blur, a quick hatchback whose agility comes at the cost of its top speed
 The S-kive Fonceur, an american muscle car. As such, it will go very fast on a straight line. Other than that, it's not very good at anything. Except of course its incredible style.


A new Timeattack map ! 

Time attack City will take you in the wide streets of an American City, while also forcing you to go through its narrow alleys.


A boost in the Race mode 

Why keep your pursuants in the mirror while you could get some more advance on them and properly show who's the fastest to all of them ?

Some boost powerup are now spread on some parts of each maps that only the best will manage to get.

What do you use to cut Pizza ?

A new Cook map where you'll fight with your fellow friends to cook the best pizza.

 Enhanced controller support 

You'll now be able to put your two feets on you desk, relax and play gatherings only with the controller.
Who drives with a keyboard anyway ??
